name: midlevel_backend
notes: Mid-level backend engineer against a senior payments JD. Tests preservation at scale (3 jobs, 2 projects, 2 certs, 1 publication, ~13 bullets) since dropping entries is this pipeline's worst failure mode. The resume is already strong and metric-dense, so a rewrite has little room to add value honestly - a model that 'improves' it a lot is probably inventing. Note CI/CD is deliberately excluded from unevidenced_jd_skills: the resume demonstrates it in substance (Jenkins to GitHub Actions, build time 14 to 6 min) but literal matching scores it missing, which is a known limitation of _contains_skill rather than a model failure.
